thread:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER ALERT: [P2] model-canary-qa — error-rate spike on canary route 'q8path-v2' in prod-us-west. 5m error rate 7.3% (baseline 0.3%). Alert: https://pagerduty/INC-2448001234

mariam (oncall): Oncall mariam here, acknowledging. Paging eng-sre and runtime. @ops-bot please start the 'canary-pager' runbook and tag relevant owners. I'll take triage until handoff.

ops-bot: Runbook started: canary-pager. Steps queued: [isolate-canary, collect-logs, compare-canary-diff, consider-pin/rollback]. Suggested commands: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-q8path`, `redwoodctl routes list --env=prod-us-west --route=canary-q8path`

sam: Noted. How many requests failing? Any customer-facing impact numbers?

mariam (oncall): Quick metrics from observability: failing reqs ~120 reqs/min on canary route, ~0.5% of total token throughput for prod-us-west. No full-service outage. CS: potential impact to a handful of heavy-LPM customers if we let canary stay.

cheng: looking at logs now. Seeing repeated tokenization mismatch errors and model stack traces referencing `tokenizer_v1` -> `tokenizer_v2` boundary. Example from runtime logs (truncated):
```
2024-11-12T21:12:03.123Z model-q8path-v2 ERROR invalid_sequence at decode_step 183
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/infer/runner.py", line 412, in decode
    tokens = tokenizer.decode_chunk(chunk)
  File "/app/tokenizers/q8_compat.py", line 89, in decode_chunk
    raise TokenizationError("mismatched token boundary")
TokenizationError: mismatched token boundary
```
This lines up with requests that have long context windows (>=2048 tokens). Hypothesis: quantization/packing in v2 changed token boundary handling for long sequences.

kevin: I ran a quick eval diff vs baseline v1 on our canary evalset 2024-11-12T20:30. Quality metric (semantic-similarity) delta: -0.12 on average. Latency +4ms. Canary failure rate correlates with 1) long prompts and 2) q8 path edge-case.

mariam (oncall): Given customer risk and quality regression, I'm going to pin the canary route back to model `q8path-v1` and stop canary traffic for v2. Plan: 1) pin route -> v1, 2) drain in-flight v2 requests, 3) validate metrics for 5 minutes, 4) notify CS. If anyone objects, say now.

sam: +1, agree. Do we have an automated pin command documented?

mariam (oncall): Using control-plane API:
```bash
# pin canary route to v1
redwoodctl routes update --env=prod-us-west --route=canary-q8path --model=q8path-v1 --pin-reason="canary error spike 2448001234"
# confirm
redwoodctl routes describe --env=prod-us-west --route=canary-q8path | jq .model
```
I'll run that now.

ops-bot: Action: route update issued by mariam. Status: in-progress.

mariam (oncall): `redwoodctl` returned 200 and route now pinned to q8path-v1. Starting drain - setting `max-inflight=0` for v2 pool.

ops-bot: Traffic routing update acknowledged by runtime. Verified new requests served by q8path-v1.

cheng: I dumped a short KV of recent error keys and matched request ids. Shared s3 link: https://s3.redwood/logs/canary-2448001234/ (private). Key errors show tokenization mismatch across ~1.7k requests during the 15m window.

kevin: Running quick diff on eval harness comparing v2->v1 for the failing subset. Output snippet:
```
-- sample_id: 9876 --
baseline (v1) similarity: 0.93
canary (v2) similarity: 0.67
status: mismatch at decode_step 183
```
This supports the hypothesis.

lisa: CS/Support note: we're preparing a customer notification draft. Impact scope: transient failures for long-prompt customers in us-west. No data exfiltration. We'll wait for final confirmation after 10m stable post-pin. :eyes:

mariam (oncall): Timeline so far (for RCA):
- 21:12:03 pager alert triggered on increased error rate for canary v2
- 21:13:10 ops runbook started; initial metrics show 120 reqs/min failing
- 21:16:45 hypothesis of tokenizer mismatch proposed (cheng) based on logs
- 21:18:30 decision to pin canary to v1 and drain v2 (mariam)
- 21:20:05 route pinned; traffic now on v1; draining v2
- ongoing: monitoring for 5-10m for regression clearance

sam: After pin, are we planning a rollback of v2 everywhere or keep it in staging until fixed?

mariam (oncall): We'll keep v2 artifacts but block rollout until patch. Next steps: 1) create ticket in eng-ml to revert the q8 packing changes and add regression tests for >2048 token flows; 2) add canary eval harness test covering long prompts; 3) prep post-mortem and timeline.

cheng: Adding debug notes to the ticket: suspected change in `q8_compat.py` at commit `a1b2c3d` that changed decode window rounding. I'll attach failing traces and minimal repro.

kevin: Will run a local reproducer by feeding >2048 token prompt through v2 quantized path and attach diff artifacts to the issue.

ops-bot: Monitoring: canary error rate decreased to 0.4% after pin. Current check: OK for now.

lisa: Confirming CS notification sent to affected accounts once we have 10m stable. Draft ready in `#customer-notifications` channel.

mariam (oncall): Thanks everyone. I'll mark incident as mitigated and start the in-incident RCA thread for timeline assembly. Please add any logs/links to the ticket ENG-ML-244800 for postmortem. I'll hand off to sam for next-day follow-up.

sam: Taking handoff. Will coordinate with eng-ml and schedule a deep-dive tomorrow. Add me to ENG-ML-244800.

mariam (oncall): Handoff complete. Closing P2 pager for now — will reopen if error rate climbs. (reacted :white_check_mark:)

ops-bot: Runbook completed: canary-pager. Final state: mitigated, route pinned, logs archived to s3://logs/canary-2448001234/; ticket ENG-ML-244800 created.

lisa: Noted for PMR/incident notes. I'll pull the timeline into the postmortem doc.

cheng: added repro steps and stack traces to ENG-ML-244800.

kevin: attaching eval diffs to the ticket now.

sam: Will sync with CS tomorrow, thx.

mariam (oncall): Closing thread. If anyone discovers additional regressed samples, please post in ENG-ML-244800 or ping me directly.
